title: Candles for {giver}'s vow
summary: {giver} of {settlement} means to swear off the drink before the altar, and the priest wants {count} × {item} for the vow.
offer: The priest won't take the vow without candles. Good ones. Will you bring them? I'd only drink the coin.
progress: The candles? My hands are shaking already.
complete: Candles. Good. Walk with me to the altar before I change my mind.
